name: Turntide Locality Knowledge Answer
customer: A Union office or enterprise that needs one source-traceable answer about practical experience in a named locality and can state the decision or research use it supports.
problemEvidence: The TTI leader supplied a concrete product case: a Union buyer asks how people have gardened in a particular town, and contributors whose licensed local experience is used share in the settled sale margin.

TTI already has a direct contribution, rights, provenance, correction, attribution, and synthetic credit-allocation design, but has not yet observed qualified buyer demand or admitted live resale inventory.

A TTI human corrected the initial USD 10 one-answer hypothesis: comparable inference may cost only cents, while the more credible funnel is free answers in chat leading to persistent Knowledge Vault access and metered MCP/A2A use by power users.

offer.promise: For one bounded subject, locality, optional time context, and allowed internal Union use, TTI will prepare one source-traceable answer of at most 1,500 words from active contributor-licensed knowledge, with context limitations, attribution, provenance, and one correction update for thirty days.
included: One admitted buyer query and deterministic rights-compatible contribution match
Human review of positive attribution weights totaling 1,000,000 ppm before the offer is frozen
One provenance-carrying answer of at most 1,500 words
One provenance or factual correction update during the P30D correction window
excluded: Personalized medical, legal, financial, safety, or emergency advice
Open-web republication, resale, sublicensing, or general model training
Answers where no active contribution grants the required resale rights
Discord-derived message content or passive server participation as sale inventory

inventory.rule: Only active, self-addressed direct-intake contributions with contributor-selected Union resale rights may match; Discord/API content is never inventory.

discordPilot.protocol: Discord guild application command /locality-pilot over TTI's zero-intent Gateway service
discordPilot.retention: permanent deliberately submitted non-personal business-evidence fields under keyed pseudonyms

territory.widerUnionBoundary: ActivityStreams authenticated buyer query and offer; x402 settlement; authenticated rights-filtered fulfillment

conversion.notEffect: A reaction is qualified discovery interest only. Only an exact-consent /locality-pilot submission becomes retained buyer-demand evidence; neither path is an offer acceptance, payment, entitlement, answer promise, revenue, contribution, license, resale permission, or permission to use an ordinary Discord message as knowledge inventory.

acquisitionFunnel.entry: Bounded source-traceable answers delivered free in Discord when TTI has rights-compatible inventory and capacity; no guaranteed response time or answer exists yet.
acquisitionFunnel.retention: Founding Knowledge Vault subscription for persistent browsing, maintained briefings, provenance, and pooled retrieval; checkout remains closed.
acquisitionFunnel.powerUser: Metered MCP for fiat-compatible callers and authenticated ActivityPub/A2A for EVML2 Union enterprises; price will be derived from observed provider cost, settlement cost, and desired margin rather than the retired USD 10 guess.
acquisitionFunnel.currentEconomicEffect: none; no free answer is promised, vault checkout is closed, metered endpoints are undeployed, and no revenue or profit exists

allocation.basis: nonnegative distributable margin after externally settled gross revenue and complete measured payment, provider, refund, and chargeback costs
allocation.maturity: after the disclosed refund and chargeback window closes

activationBlockers: At least one active live contribution licensed for Union resale
Qualified legal and tax review of contributor terms, credits, payout, buyer license, refund, and correction law
Qualified buyer terms/security review and production deployment of the verified authenticated direct Union buyer-query ingress
TTI production-chain smart-account binding and pay-to address
Base-mainnet six-decimal USDC contract evidence bound to the exact payment asset
Admitted production x402 facilitator with capability and attributable-cost receipts
Unexpired exact one-sale production activation witnessed in TTI's settlement store and binding account, asset, facilitator, buyer law, and public HTTPS origin
Authenticated buyer delivery and correction channel

measurement.qualifiedInterest: Distinct human reaction actors on the exact marked discovery message, aggregated without projecting Discord identity
measurement.qualifiedDemand: Distinct admitted no-charge pilot queries, segmented by free chat, persistent vault, metered MCP, and metered A2A delivery interest
measurement.conversion: Free-answer request to fulfilled free answer, fulfilled answer to vault interest or subscription, and power-user interest to metered settled call are reported separately
measurement.fulfillment: Authenticated delivery receipts for provenance-complete answers and correction-window outcomes
measurement.economics: Externally settled revenue minus receipted direct costs, matured contributor credits, refunds, chargebacks, and attributable operating costs; unknowns remain unknown
measurement.retention: A buyer settlement placing a later admitted query after receiving a prior fulfillment

nextExperiment.cadence: hourly aggregate observation; hold until 48 hours; at most one public reminder; early pass on all thresholds; interview decision at fourteen days
nextExperiment.hypothesis: Within fourteen days, at least three distinct humans will express interest in a free source-traceable locality answer, at least one will deliberately submit a no-charge bounded query through /locality-pilot, and at least one will declare persistent-vault or metered-MCP/A2A interest.
nextExperiment.pass: qualified interest actors >= 3; no-charge query-pilot actors >= 1; downstream vault-or-metered-power-user interest actors >= 1
nextExperiment.onPass: Pilot one rights-compatible free Discord answer, measure fulfillment cost, then test conversion to the existing vault offer or a cost-grounded metered interface without reviving the USD 10 guess.
nextExperiment.onFail: Interview participants about buyer, subject, locality granularity, free-answer usefulness, persistence, power-user protocol, trust, and command friction before changing the product.
